companyDescription: Quantum computing · trapped-ion systems + networking/quantum-security rollup (Elisity pending) · FY26 revenue guide $280-290M, organic growth 132% · freshly recapitalized with a $2B equity raise
priceNote: Live $30.15 (-3.6%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $25.89-$73.65, ~59% off the high. Market cap ~$12.9B. The $2B raise priced at $40/unit (15% premium) on Oct 14; shares have traded ~25% below that since.
summary: IonQ reports Q3 on Nov 5 (company-confirmed), its first print since an aggressive October: a $1.15B all-stock Elisity deal and a $2B equity raise. The stock now trades ~25% below that raise's price. Fundamentals are strong — Q2 revenue $80M (+287%), organic growth 132%, FY26 guide $280-290M — and consensus sits at $64 (+112%, clears the 20% gate easily). earnings_beat is the largest core bucket (n=42, +1.8pp vs +1.4pp overall); tier-2 doesn't penalize it. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +20% assumes a ~1-3 month horizon for a clean beat to re-rate toward the $36-40 raise price. แนะนำ 3-5% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: Company-confirmed for Nov 5 after the close. First print after the $2B equity raise ($40/unit, a 15% premium) and the $1.15B Elisity deal. The read is the FY26 $280-290M guide, gross margin, and how management frames the dilution.

catalysts.name: Elisity acquisition close
catalysts.description: $1.15B all-stock (+ up to $150M earn-out) zero-trust security deal; adds recurring software revenue to the quantum-networking/security stack.

risks: Dilution: the $2B raise (20.5M shares + 29.5M pre-funded warrants) plus 100M seven-year warrants at $69.46 and Elisity's all-stock consideration expand the share count materially; growth must outrun it.
Sell-the-news history: IONQ fell ~4% on its Aug 2026 beat-and-raise; a beat alone may not be enough.
Still deeply loss-making (TTM net loss ~$1.36B incl. non-cash items) — valuation rests on long-dated quantum adoption.
Integration risk from serial M&A (Elisity on top of prior networking/security acquisitions).
High beta to yields and to quantum-peer sentiment (RGTI, QBTS moved in sympathy with the raise).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Now well-capitalized after the $2B raise, so financing risk is low. But quantum is among the highest-beta, longest-duration growth trades, and it sold off with yields in October.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.
